caption: Raah · No loan rejection is a dead end
say: This is Raah, from Team Alltra. Because no loan rejection should be a dead end.

caption: Ravi, a delivery partner in Pune, applies for ₹1,00,000
say: Meet Ravi, a delivery partner in Pune. He applies for a one lakh rupee personal loan, right inside Paytm.

caption: Today: a one-line sorry, and a customer who walks away
say: And today, this is where it ends. A one line sorry, and a customer who walks away.

caption: Raah steps in, in Ravi's own language
say: Raah steps in. It explains the real reason in Ravi's own language, out loud.

caption: Raah explains in Marathi · Sarvam-105B + Bulbul voice
No credit history: the bureau had nothing to score
say: Ravi has never had a loan or a card, so the credit bureau had nothing to score. Let's switch to English.

caption: One Account Aggregator consent: every bank account, any UPI app
say: But a credit report isn't the whole story. With one Account Aggregator consent, Raah reads six months of his bank statements, from every account, whichever UPI app he pays with.

caption: The AI reads raw narrations: nearly ₹28,000 a month of gig income
say: Sarvam's model reads every raw transaction. It finds nearly twenty eight thousand rupees a month in Swiggy, Zomato and Rapido payouts, hidden behind legal company names that keyword rules miss.

caption: Reader 99% right vs keyword rules 71% · the AI labels, the rules count
say: On these statements the reader is ninety nine percent right. Keyword rules, seventy one. And the AI only labels. Every rupee is counted by the lender's rules.

caption: Approved today: ₹40,000 on his cash flow
say: So Ravi qualifies today. A forty thousand rupee loan, approved on his cash flow, and an FD backed card to start his credit record.

caption: A 90-day plan from his own data · Raah watches every month
say: Then a ninety day plan, built from his own data. Each month Raah reads the new statements, re-runs the rules, and nudges him along.

caption: Day 90: every rule passes · nothing is sent without his OK
say: On day ninety, every rule passes. Nothing is sent without Ravi's OK. One tap of consent.

caption: Rules decide · the AI reads and explains · the customer consents
say: Every step is audited. The rules decide, the AI reads and explains, and the customer consents. Powered by Sarvam: Sarvam one zero five B, Bulbul and Saaras.

caption: Same engine, another customer: Priya
say: Same engine, a different customer. Priya is salaried, but her card is nearly full, and her loan was rejected too. She shares her statements the same way, and Raah reads both of her bank accounts and her Paytm bills together.

caption: Priya: two debts her credit report never showed
say: And it is honest. For Priya, the reader finds two debts her credit report never showed, so Raah lowers her offer instead of pushing her into more debt.

caption: Every “no” becomes “not yet.”
say: Every no becomes not yet. Raah, by Team Alltra.
